ask: Dr Shah's feedback is in the txt file, please sort it
notes: Messy feedback from a clinician. 'Fonts look cheap' is vague taste and should get a concrete reading. 'Who's running late' is a new feature, not a design note: a good intake flags it (row in the list with a default, or out of scope).
message:
I will rework the Northside Physio prototype from Dr Shah's five notes, then check every screen before and after.

**Found:**
- Prototype: `proto-clinic/index.html`, plain HTML with four screens: Today, Clients, Invoices, Settings (from the folder)
- Notes: `feedback-from-dr-shah.txt`, five bullets (from the folder)
- No reference to copy and no `CLAUDE.md` or design skill, so I use my built-in design checks
- "Customers" is the only place the word is used. The nav, table and search all say "Clients", so I pick "Clients" (from the code)
- The blue "New appointment" button on Today has no handler, which is the dead button Dr Shah means (from the code)
- A browser for screenshots works

**Track:** full, because there is no reference, so both tracks are the same.
**Coverage:** 4 clear · partial: Main flow, Edge cases, Look · missing: Words with no number

**Done means:**
- All 5 notes are done, with a result I checked on the page
- "Customers" is gone from every screen
- No screen changed that no note names
- The prototype's link answers 200

**My list of notes**
R1 clients page: rename the title "Customers" to "Clients" (everywhere)
R2 today: the "New appointment" button opens a form and Save adds a row (my reading)
R3 all screens: one clean font, headings semibold (my reading, everywhere)
R4 settings: replace the Latin booking policy text with real words
R5 today: show who is running late (my reading)

Anything missing or wrong? Notes you send later still join this run.

About 40 minutes and 3 helper agents, within a budget of 60 minutes.

1. What should "New appointment" do?
   Recommended: open a small form (client, therapist, type, time, room); Save adds a row to today's list. Sample data only, nothing is stored.
   Why it matters: "doesn't do anything" has many fixes, and the form decides what gets built.
2. How should we see who is running late?
   Recommended: a Status column on Today ("On time" or "Running late 10 min") and a "1 running late" box next to the other three. The late times are made-up sample data.
   Why it matters: the prototype has no clock or check-in, so this decides whether it is a column, a banner or a separate list.
3. What does "cheap fonts" mean for the look?
   Recommended: keep to system fonts, with no download: a larger 16px body, 600 weight headings, and more room between lines.
   Why it matters: a web font such as Inter needs internet on the iPad, and the demo may not have it.
4. What should the Booking policy say?
   Recommended: "Appointments can be moved or cancelled up to 24 hours before at no charge. Later changes are charged in full."
   Why it matters: this is a made-up rule that Dr Shah may read as the clinic's real one.
5. Should I also fix the tight table rows on Today and the other screens?
   Recommended: no. Dr Shah did not name them, so I list them as a proposal.
   Why it matters: it would change screens no note asks about.

Reply with your answers, or just "go" to use the defaults.
